issue.title: Capture dry-run previews the canonical requirement block (NOTES filing) instead of authored order
issue.description:
Proposed by research.5u.final (DISCOVERED ISSUE note #7 on epic bob-cli-on, from the cld researcher's reproduction; evidence file:explicit:9cb60732bf9ab7a6de1c0bf0 §"Side findings" 1 and the consolidated report file:explicit:5c353b4ff461108eaf7e16eb §4.9). Triaged by the bob-cli-on land agent.

When a capture draft gives a task requirements plus loose notes, `bob capture --dry-run` shows the notes in authored order. The human preview and the JSON `sub_bullets` list each note as a loose child of the task. The real write follows the NOTES rule (`docs/task-requirements.md` §3): the reqs go into the reqs zone and the notes are filed under a `NOTES` drawer. Only the `⌗⌗ … · files {n} notes under NOTES` summary line hints at this. Bob Mac Capture renders the preview stack from `sub_bullets`, so it shows a block that differs from what lands.

The bob-cli-on.6.1 land agent accepted this as the documented contract when capture-reqs landed (docs/capture.md says the dry-run lists authored order while the written block is canonical). So this is a proposal, not a regression: preview the canonical block that will be written, and add an additive per-line `req`/`kind` field so clients can draw requirement rows (the research's proposal).

Out of scope for bob-cli-on because that epic's plan only required the summary line ("The dry run and the preview say so: files {n} notes under NOTES"), which ships. Changing preview ordering is a client-visible JSON change for the Mac preview stack, so the two repos must coordinate it.

task_type_fields.proposal: Make bob capture --dry-run (human and JSON sub_bullets) list the block as task_block_layout will write it, with the reqs zone first and notes filed under NOTES. Add an additive per-line req/kind field on preview lines so Bob Mac Capture can render requirement rows. Then update the Mac preview stack to consume it.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-on's plan required only the 'files {n} notes under NOTES' summary, which shipped, and its capture-reqs lander explicitly accepted the authored-order preview as documented contract. Reordering preview lines is a cross-repo JSON/UI change beyond the epic's acceptance.

issue.creation_reason: Research for the task-requirements display redesign showed the Mac preview stack draws a different block than capture writes when notes are scooped into NOTES; the epic accepted the summary-line preview, so the full canonical preview is a separate improvement.
